SPY: An ETF tracking the S&P 500, a broad benchmark of the 500 largest U.S. public companies.
DIA: An ETF tracking the Dow Jones Industrial Average, a price-weighted index of 30 large U.S. blue-chip companies.
QQQ: An ETF tracking the Nasdaq-100, a benchmark of the 100 largest non-financial companies listed on the Nasdaq, heavily weighted toward technology.
RSP: An equal-weight ETF tracking the S&P 500, giving each of the 500 companies the same weighting rather than weighting by market cap.
IWM: An ETF tracking the Russell 2000, a benchmark of U.S. small-cap companies.
MAGS: An ETF holding the "Magnificent Seven" mega-cap technology stocks.
BTC-USD: Bitcoin, the largest cryptocurrency by market capitalization, priced in U.S. dollars.
ETH-USD: Ethereum, the second-largest cryptocurrency by market capitalization, priced in U.S. dollars.
GC=F: Gold futures, a contract for the future delivery of gold, widely used as a safe-haven asset and inflation hedge.
SI=F: Silver futures, a contract for the future delivery of silver, used both as a precious metal and an industrial input.
CL=F: Crude oil futures (WTI), a contract for the future delivery of West Texas Intermediate crude, a key global energy benchmark.
HG=F: Copper futures, a contract for the future delivery of copper, often watched as a gauge of global industrial demand.
ES=F: E-mini S&P 500 futures, a contract tracking the S&P 500 index used to trade or hedge broad market exposure outside regular trading hours.
YM=F: E-mini Dow futures, a contract tracking the Dow Jones Industrial Average outside regular trading hours.
NQ=F: E-mini Nasdaq-100 futures, a contract tracking the Nasdaq-100 index outside regular trading hours.
XLK: Technology Select Sector SPDR Fund, an ETF tracking S&P 500 technology companies.
XLC: Communication Services Select Sector SPDR Fund, an ETF tracking S&P 500 communication services companies.
XLY: Consumer Discretionary Select Sector SPDR Fund, an ETF tracking S&P 500 consumer discretionary companies.
XLF: Financial Select Sector SPDR Fund, an ETF tracking S&P 500 financial companies.
XLI: Industrial Select Sector SPDR Fund, an ETF tracking S&P 500 industrial companies.
XLE: Energy Select Sector SPDR Fund, an ETF tracking S&P 500 energy companies.
XLV: Health Care Select Sector SPDR Fund, an ETF tracking S&P 500 health care companies.
XLP: Consumer Staples Select Sector SPDR Fund, an ETF tracking S&P 500 consumer staples companies.
XLU: Utilities Select Sector SPDR Fund, an ETF tracking S&P 500 utility companies.
XLB: Materials Select Sector SPDR Fund, an ETF tracking S&P 500 materials companies.
XLRE: Real Estate Select Sector SPDR Fund, an ETF tracking S&P 500 real estate companies.
^VIX: The CBOE Volatility Index, a measure of expected S&P 500 volatility over the next 30 days, often called the market's "fear gauge."
FEAR_GREED: A composite gauge of overall market sentiment, ranging from Extreme Fear to Extreme Greed based on several market indicators.
PUT_CALL: The ratio of put options traded to call options traded, used as a gauge of investor sentiment -- a high ratio suggests more hedging or bearishness.
